title: Mac 1.0.2 install: hold the first launch until the owner removes the old containers
context: Owner 2026-10-14 asked for a clean 1.0.2 install on Windows and this Mac, test remnants removed, opened at onboarding without completing it. On the Mac, trash of ~/Library/Containers/dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes and dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotesFix was refused (afpAccessDenied -5000), as on 2026-10-12. 1.0.2 uses the same bundle id dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes, so a launch now would open the old container's data. A background wait-then-open loop was refused by the hold-loop hook.
options: Install 1.0.2 now, reveal the container in Finder, and open the app only after the owner moves both containers to the Trash
Open 1.0.2 now on the old container
Delete the container contents from the shell
option_reasons: Gives the clean onboarding start the owner asked for and keeps every removal recoverable
Would load old test data and could skip onboarding, and writes into the container the owner wants gone
Permanent deletion, and working around macOS's refusal; container removal is owner-only
outcome: Installed 1.0.2 to /Applications (signature valid, no quarantine), revealed the container in Finder, did not launch. Next: owner trashes both containers, then open -a "/Applications/Field Notes.app".
